jurisdiction_scope: India-first product policy with jurisdiction review

policy_evidence.rule: Require a covered controlled-goods subject plus a current sale, supply, delivery, payment, or access signal before creating a review-only Illegal Activities candidate.
Require explicit unlicensed or prohibited weapon context plus a current transaction or distribution signal; neutral discussion and licensed activity are not illegal findings.
Explicitly illegal or unlicensed betting requires current promotion, signup, payment, or access evidence; legality is not inferred from ordinary gaming language.
Commercial facilitation of prohibited sexual services is review-only. Child-risk, coercion, harassment, and trafficking signals remain owned by higher-priority safety processes.
A current offer to supply forged identity material, counterfeit currency, or money-laundering services is a review-only candidate.
Potential commercial misuse of protected official symbols requires jurisdiction-aware human review and is never a final legal determination.

Reporting, prevention, research, history, criticism, education, fiction, quoted material, and museum or professional context do not become Illegal Activities without a current real-world transaction signal.
Unknown licensing, location, legality, purpose, or transaction status routes to Uncertain and human review rather than an Illegal or Allow determination.
